usage: agentware graph run [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--i-approve-manifest]
                           [--concurrency CONCURRENCY]
                           [--node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT] [--deadline DEADLINE]
                           [--now NOW]
                           name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --i-approve-manifest  authorize the AUTONOMOUS non-self-extension portion
  --concurrency CONCURRENCY
                        override the manifest concurrency
  --node-timeout NODE_TIMEOUT
                        per-node wall-clock watchdog hours (default 24)
  --deadline DEADLINE   whole-run deadline hours (default 48)
  --now NOW             inject the clock (ISO) for byte-identical replay
